messages:
emma: Heads up team — docs PR #3310 contains a migration guide update, a new SDK snippet for connection pooling, and a small link-fix. We need it merged before the feature-flag freeze at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Can reviewers sign off on timing?

ryan: I can review now. Will focus on wording and CI errors. @olivia can you double-check the API details in the snippet?

olivia: on it. Quick Q: the snippet uses client.open({pool: true}) — is that the final API or should it be client.connect()?

emma: dev note: we standardized on client.connect for the public SDK surface. The PR author left client.open to match internal examples. We should update public docs to client.connect and mention compat.

ci-bot: Preview build failed: broken reference in migration-guide.md -> ./old-snapshot-instructions.md (404). Log: https://ci.redwood/preview/3310/logs

sasha: that reference was from the legacy TOC. I'll update to the canonical /guides/snapshots link.

ryan: small procedural question: should this land to main or to release/v1.8? Ops told me anything that impacts FF rollout text should go to the release branch.

emma: ops preference is release/v1.8. We need to ensure the release branch goes through the branch-deploy checklist (canary + smoke tests).

ops-ally: Confirmed — FF freeze starts 10:00 PT tomorrow. Anything merged after freeze without ops approval will be reverted. Please target release/v1.8.

olivia: about backwards compatibility
: the updated snippet (client.connect({pool: true})) requires SDK >=2.1. We should add a callout: "Requires SDK v2.1+" and link to the upgrade notes.

emma: agreed. Add a short upgrade callout in the migration guide and add a one-line Release Note under v1.8 (SDK: connection pooling snippet). Keep it minimal.

sasha: pushed fix: updated link to /guides/snapshots, changed snippet to client.connect, added the SDK v2.1+ callout. Re-triggering preview.

ci-bot: Preview build started.

ci-bot: Preview build succeeded  0: https://preview.docs.redwood/3310 (expires in 48h).

devex-bot: Merge slot request accepted for thread 2068001111. Tentative slot reserved for 09:20 PT tomorrow into release/v1.8. React :thumbsup: to confirm.

ryan: LGTM from me pending one tiny grammar nit (I'll push in-PR).

olivia: API accuracy check done. No functional concerns.

emma: thanks all. @devex-bot please proceed with the merge at 09:20 PT if CI stays green. If any new changes slip in after 09:00 PT we'll hold and escalate to ops.

ops-ally: noted. If the slot is used, ops will run the smoke canary and confirm flag behavior before release window.

ryan: pushed the grammar nit. Approving now.

emma: Approved. Proceed to open the backport PR into release/v1.8 and tag ops for canary.

devex-bot: Merge slot confirmed. Backport PR created: https://git.redwood/3310/backport-to-release/v1.8

emma: all good. If anything changes, post here and ping ops. Otherwise we should be green for the freeze cutoff.
